official_access.access_mode: AWS Open Data Cloud Service; anonymous S3/HTTPS retrieval
official_access.legacy_services: Do not use the retired FTP Article Datasets, OA Web Service, or legacy AWS prefixes after the August 2026 transition.

snapshot_policy.rule: Pin the PMC Cloud Service inventory used for acquisition and identify the run by a deterministic SHA-256 over the selected inventory rows/object identifiers, timestamps and ETags. A wall-clock date alone is not a sufficient snapshot.

license_policy.rule: The source adapter may inspect all lawfully retrieved text-mining records, but publication to the Atlas Internet Archive lake must default to rows whose article-level license is conservatively cleared for derived redistribution. Other rows require an explicit legal/policy decision recorded in a run.

adapter.input: JATS XML files retrieved through the official PMC Cloud Service
